13:13.race_name: Racing To School Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: A maiden with ability; needs to settle better but this sharp track could benefit him
runners.name: Down To Business
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat form at about 1m2f; beaten in the region of 10l in his two runs over hurdles despite taking a firm grip (tongue tied last time on soft; 2.25l behind Talakan); needs to settle better but this sharp track could benefit him.

runners.comment: Lightly raced on the Flat, last seen winning a 1m4f maiden on the AW last May
runners.name: Gallivanted
runners.spotlight: Had just three Flat races for Tom Clover and won the latest last May, a 1m4f AW maiden; sold for 70,000gns; gelded and had wind surgery ahead of this hurdling debut and the yard won this race last year; should be very competitive if taking to it and handling the ground.

runners.comment: Dual Flat winner who has made a bright start over hurdles; met a good one last time
runners.name: King Al
runners.spotlight: Dual Flat winner, over 1m on heavy and 1m2f on good; shaped okay in a useful race at Sandown on his hurdling debut and was clear of the rest behind a good horse at Kempton last month; firmly in the mix.

runners.comment: Very limited maiden on the Flat (0-11) and makes no real appeal on this change of codes
runners.name: Lasswade
runners.spotlight: Very limited maiden on the Flat (0-11) and makes no real appeal on this change of codes; hood added.

runners.comment: Latest third at Taunton is below the level that some in here have achieved
runners.name: Madame De Labrunie
runners.spotlight: Had eight races in France, winning a claiming hurdle on very soft ground; latest third at Taunton is below the level that some in here have achieved.

runners.comment: Flat winner in France; encouraging third on hurdling debut at Ascot last month (soft)
runners.name: Talakan
runners.spotlight: Bought for 40,000euros after winning over 1m6f in France (heavy) when in the Aga Khan colours; encouraging hurdling debut when third at Ascot (soft) and would have been closer without a late mistake; commands respect.

runners.comment: A repeat of his fourth at Cheltenham would give him every chance at this level
runners.name: Wolf Rayet
runners.spotlight: Entered in the Triumph; modest Flat form in Ireland, albeit in just three races; already better over hurdles and was only 11l off the winner in a Class 2 juvenile hurdle at Cheltenham in December (soft) when just behind the smart One Horse Town who has since finished second in a Grade 2; every chance.

runners.comment: Comfortably held in two bumpers, on good ground here and then soft at Hereford
runners.name: Silvereen
runners.spotlight: Comfortably held in two bumpers, on good ground here and then soft at Hereford; bred to have a future over jumps but an unlikely winner on this occasion.

13:48.race_name: C M Bespoke Care Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: She'll need improvement in the tongue-tie if she's to win this
runners.name: Afancy Getaway
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Mrs S N J Embiricos
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner on yielding to soft; beaten over 20l in 2m3f/2m6f races for mares this winter and she'll need improvement in the tongue-tie if she's to win this.

runners.comment: Back from an absence to finish a well-held third in a 2m4f seller a month ago
runners.name: Borna Gem
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced Irish point winner; back from an absence to finish a well-held third in a 2m4f seller a month ago and this task is tougher than that.

runners.comment: Solid form figures in five points, the win coming in a small field on good ground
runners.name: Catwalk Girl
runners.owner: The Galloping Dentist At 45 The Green
runners.spotlight: Solid form figures in five points, the win coming in a small field on good ground; likely up against it in a race of this nature.

runners.comment: 13-race maiden in France but ran in strong hurdle races; recruited for 160,000euros
runners.name: Diamond Du Berlais
runners.spotlight: Unable to win any of her 13 races over hurdles in France but she contested some strong contests and earned placed honours at Grade 2 and 3 level (on heavy); recruited by her top connections for 160,000euros; the only runner on the card for Willie Mullins who is 1-2 at this track; if on her game after a lengthy break she could easily outclass this opposition.

runners.comment: 0-2 in bumpers and 0-4 over hurdles, and her third was remote; has no form claims
runners.name: Feeling Frisky
runners.spotlight: 0-2 in bumpers and 0-4 over hurdles, and her third was remote; has no form claims.

runners.comment: Ran better in her second bumper at Fontwell but that's still ordinary form
runners.name: Jax Belle
runners.spotlight: Sister to the stable's smart Jax Junior; ran as though something was amiss on her bumper debut and, although the Fontwell run in new cheekpieces was better, that's still ordinary form; stable second-string according to jockey bookings.

runners.comment: Bought for £28,000 after winning an Irish point by 8l last spring (on yielding)
runners.name: Jurassic Pet
runners.spotlight: Bought for £28,000 after winning an Irish point by 8l last spring (on yielding); could have a future for Sara Bradstock but chasing will be more her thing; had wind surgery and a tongue-tie goes on.

runners.comment: Well held on hurdling debut at Fontwell after an absence; could be sharper here
runners.name: Khutulun Khan
runners.spotlight: Raced twice in bumpers two seasons ago, managing a third on Ascot debut; went off 20-1 for her hurdling introduction after an absence at Fontwell (2m1f, soft) and was beaten 20l; could be considerably sharper here.

runners.comment: On the retreat when falling two out over C&D before Christmas; bit to prove after that run
runners.name: No Flies On Her
runners.owner: Noel Fehily Racing Syndicate - No Flies
runners.spotlight: Joined Fergal O'Brien for £50,000 after winning an Irish point; positives to take from her bumper run at Warwick (2m, good to soft) when 8l off a useful winner but she was on the retreat when falling two out over C&D just before Christmas; bit to prove after that run.

runners.comment: Pulled up at huge odds in two low-grade handicap hurdles this season (3m1f/3m2f)
runners.name: Porridge
runners.spotlight: Pulled up at huge odds in two low-grade handicap hurdles this season (3m1f/3m2f).

runners.comment: Second in an Irish point but pulled up on hurdling debut when a 16-1 chance
runners.name: Warrioress
runners.spotlight: Bought for £30,000 after runner-up in Irish point; behind when hitting two out at Stratford and soon pulled up; she was weak in the betting at 16-1.

runners.comment: Impossible to make a form case after heavy defeats under rules
runners.name: Wishful Wings
runners.spotlight: Impossible to make a form case after heavy defeats under rules.

runners.comment: Tailed off in two of his three races over hurdles and was beaten 21l in the other
runners.name: Can U Feel It
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in two of his three races over hurdles and was beaten 21l in the other (here); looks one for handicaps.

runners.comment: His second in small-field Warwick bumper (good) isn't bad form; that was last May
runners.name: Emerald Time
runners.spotlight: His second in small-field Warwick bumper (good) last May isn't bad form when the third Ladies Day has been second in two useful bumpers this season; could have some part to play on hurdling debut.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De La Haie Neuve
runners.comment: Down the field in two bumpers and a similar tale over hurdles; outclassed here
runners.name: Fanny Moon
runners.spotlight: Down the field in two bumpers and a similar tale over hurdles; outclassed here.

runners.comment: Respectable fourth on Monday; unlikely to provide the answer if he's turned out again
runners.name: Joeybottles
runners.spotlight: All runs on good to soft; third in a Perth bumper and left his first run over hurdles behind when fourth in a 2m maiden at Southwell on Monday (fitted in a first-time tongue-tie); unlikely to provide the answer if he's turned out again.

runners.comment: Posted similar RPRs in three runs over hurdles and needs to find extra here
runners.name: Kado Sacree
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner on soft; posted similar RPRs in three runs over hurdles and there are no obvious reasons why he should unearth the improvement needed to beat the best of these; however, worth keeping an eye on with a view to handicaps.

runners.comment: Bumper winner; stumbled badly three out when beaten 15l at Cheltenham the last time
runners.name: Kiwi Rush
runners.spotlight: Kelso bumper winner; positives to take from both runs over hurdles and he stumbled badly three out when beaten 15l at Cheltenham the last time (at odds of only 7-2; 2m4f, good; perhaps better on softer); one to consider.

runners.comment: Runner-up over hurdles in France; market drifter (40s) when tailed off in a Newbury novice
runners.name: Lejo Du Seuil
runners.spotlight: Runner-up over hurdles in France; market drifter (40-1) when tailed off in a Newbury novice.

runners.comment: Dual hurdle winner; fell two out at Cheltenham and hadn't been asked a serious question
runners.name: Sherminator
runners.spotlight: Left Emma Lavelle after winning a soft-ground juvenile hurdle at Newbury; comfortably defied a penalty at Taunton (good) and, following wind surgery and a break, hadn't been asked any serious questions when suffering a heavy fall two out at Cheltenham in December in a race won by the Supreme favourite Old Park Star; retains plenty of potential.

runners.comment: Ran okay in two Sedgefield bumpers but came up well short
runners.name: Drakaris
runners.spotlight: Ran okay in two Sedgefield bumpers but came up well short and Harry Skelton rides the yard's other one.

runners.comment: Runner-up in a Galway bumper back in 2023 but showed little in two maidens for mares
runners.name: Final Escape
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a Galway bumper back in 2023 but showed little in two maidens for mares after joining current yard and she's returning from another absence.

runners.comment: Ridden quieter at Huntingdon and stayed on takingly behind respected opposition
runners.name: First Candidate
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner; too keen before falling on hurdle debut but ridden quieter at Huntingdon (good to soft; first-time tongue-tie) and stayed on takingly to finish fifth behind respected opposition; more needed but improvement is very feasible.

runners.comment: First bumper run was far more promising than the second; opposable on hurdle debut
runners.name: Jessies Giant
runners.spotlight: First bumper run was far more promising than the second and this looks a big ask on hurdling introduction.

14:58.race_name: Attwood Memorial Trophy Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Plenty went right last time at Hereford (10lb lower) but looks a chaser on the upgrade
runners.name: Rodney
runners.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner; fell when appearing to have it in the bag on his chase debut and perhaps remembering that tumble when below par next time; has since got himself firmly back on track with wins at Leicester (2m, good) and Hereford (2m5f, soft); benefited from sitting off a strong pace last time and has gone up 10lb, but looks a chaser on the upgrade.

runners.comment: Encouraging run at Newbury and returning to slower ground over further could be beneficial
runners.name: Joker De Mai
runners.spotlight: Won a hunter chase under former owner David Maxwell in March; sold for £90,000 in October; his quiet stable debut was at Cheltenham and he showed more at Newbury when about 11l off the winner (2m); returning to slower ground over further could be beneficial; respected.

runners.comment: The Southwell race he won fell apart but a 4lb rise isn't the end of the world
runners.name: Charles Ritz
runners.spotlight: His second win over fences when returning from a long absence to take a 2m4f handicap at Southwell (good to soft; won on heavy) in mid-December; that race fell apart in behind but a 4lb rise isn't the end of the world.

runners.comment: Talented in Ireland but never got remotely involved on stable debut at Haydock
runners.name: Palamon
runners.spotlight: Capable hurdler on his day in Ireland and was runner-up on his chase debut there last summer; jumping has been an issue since then and he never got remotely involved on stable debut at Haydock (2m; after wind operation); hard to be confident.

runners.comment: He was well behind Toothless on return to fences at Windsor (after wind operation)
runners.name: Tax For Max
runners.spotlight: Appealingly handicapped on best hurdle form for Willie Mullins for whom he also won a beginners' chase; however, not overly convincing in first four runs for this yard and was well behind Toothless on return to fences at Windsor (after wind operation).

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De La Haie Neuve Et Al
runners.comment: His second run back from long absence when nicely on top in the finish at Windsor; up 5lb
runners.name: Toothless
runners.spotlight: His second run back from a long absence when nicely on top in the finish at Windsor (2m4f, good; Jay Tidball claimed his 5lb); a 5lb rise isn't overly offputting but he does seem particularly effective on goodish ground.

runners.comment: Near miss over C&D in December; ridden too positively when behind Rodney at Hereford
runners.name: Pepe Le Moko
runners.spotlight: Rallied for a near miss over C&D in December (Regal Renaissance challenging when falling) and he was part responsible for the strong pace off which Rodney won at Hereford (2m5f, soft); capable of being involved should this pan out more favourably.

runners.breeder: Mr & Mrs D & T Futter & Mr B Keogh
runners.comment: In the process of running another good race at this track when falling two out in December
runners.name: Regal Renaissance
runners.spotlight: In the process of running another good race at this track when falling two out over this trip just before Christmas; she's on her last winning mark and has to be feared; seems fine on all ground.

15:33.race_name: Late Roy Kneller 85th Birthday Mares' Handicap Hurdle (Qualifier For Challenger Mares' Series Final)

runners.comment: Won valuable final of this series last April but would appeal much more on good ground
runners.name: Greyval
runners.spotlight: Returned to hurdling with respectable sixth at Kempton (3m, good) just after Christmas and is now only 2lb higher than when winning valuable final of this series at Cheltenham (2m4f, good) last April but the ground here will probably be slower than she prefers.

runners.comment: Career-best form when winning from the front over C&D in December; respected
runners.name: Masked Dance
runners.spotlight: Posted career-best performance when winning from the front over C&D (good to soft) in December, her third success over hurdles; 5lb higher now but that form was recently boosted by the clear runner-up; respected.

runners.comment: Low-mileage 6yo; below form last time but has possibilities if aided by new cheekpieces
runners.name: Dramatic Encore
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo who won Huntingdon maiden (2m4f, good to soft) just under a year ago; failed to build upon encouraging seasonal/handicap debut when well-held fourth at Sandown (2m4f, soft) in December but has possibilities if aided by new cheekpieces here; tongue-tie left off.

runners.breeder: G Durrheim And Maria Mulcahy Durrheim
runners.comment: Just 1-8 over hurdles but ended 2025 with two good efforts; probably won't be far way
runners.name: Pismo Beach
runners.spotlight: Just 1-8 over hurdles but kept on well to take fourth from out of the weights in good Cheltenham handicap (2m4f, good to soft) in December and also ran well when placed in Warwick novice (2m5f, good to soft) at end of that month; won't be far away if she copes with the slower ground here; tongue-tie added.

runners.comment: Returned from long absence with two low-key runs in November; revival needed
runners.name: Notnowlinda
runners.spotlight: Returned from long absence with two low-key runs in November (2m/2m7f); might well turn things around at some point but would appeal more on good ground and Harry Skelton evidently favours stablemare Sallyville Lady.

runners.comment: Dual 2m course winner; back from long absence with satisfactory run in December; stamina?
runners.name: Magical Maggie
runners.spotlight: Dual 2m course winner in 2023 (both times on soft); returned from long absence with quite encouraging run over that trip here (good to soft) two months ago and has slipped to a good mark but her stamina for 2m5f must be taken on trust.

runners.comment: Won twice in early 2025 but returned from layoff with heavy defeat in December
runners.name: Our Bills Aunt
runners.spotlight: Made all at Wetherby (2m3f, soft; form worked out well) just under a year ago but wasn't seen again until heavy defeat at Leicester (2m4f, soft) in December and needs to have taken significant benefit from that run.

runners.comment: Made the frame in two novice hurdles in the autumn; can improve in handicaps; big player
runners.name: Sallyville Lady
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner who shaped with significant promise when making the frame in two slow-ground novice hurdles in the autumn (2m5f/2m6f); should have improvement to come in handicaps; high on the list.

runners.comment: Ended 2025 with two creditable seconds and may still have a bigger performance in her
runners.name: Hard Dealt
runners.spotlight: Won Worcester novice (2m4f, good) last spring and ended 2025 with two creditable handicap seconds behind the same progressive rival, latterly at Aintree (2m4f, good to soft) on Boxing Day; should be fine on the forecast slower ground here and may still have a bigger run in her.

runners.comment: Stayed on well to score by 6l at Ffos Las in November; player if emphasis is on stamina
runners.name: Hellfire Princess
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced over last couple of years but bounced back to form at Ffos Las (2m6f, soft) in November, staying on well to win by 6l; subsequent 6lb rise may not be beyond her if the emphasis is on stamina again.

runners.comment: Looked held before falling quite heavily on last month's seasonal/stable debut
runners.name: Victoria Milano
runners.spotlight: Very well handicapped on some of her old form for Alastair Ralph but looked held before falling quite heavily on last month's seasonal/stable debut; considered only if lively in the betting.

runners.comment: Probably has to improve for the longer trip but pedigree offers hope in that respect
runners.name: Unleash The Beast
runners.spotlight: Best form when runner-up in a maiden hurdle 12 months ago (2m, good to soft); well held in two handicaps and the writing was on the wall a long way out on his return at Chepstow; what could help is this longer trip with him a half-brother to smart staying chaser Cloth Cap.

runners.comment: Still looked green in front when winning at Warwick so could well cope with 8lb more
runners.name: Following Chapter
runners.spotlight: Only his second run in a handicap when a 4l winner at Warwick (2m3f, good to soft) where he was backed into favouritism; still looked green in front that day and might well be up to defying the 8lb rise.

runners.comment: 28-1 for handicap debut over C&D and there was no improvement in that run; down only 2lb
runners.name: Windsor Blue
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced mare but was 28-1 for her handicap debut over C&D and there was no improvement in that run; down only 2lb.

runners.comment: Behind Shuil Ceoil last time at Exeter and wouldn't be certain to back that up
runners.name: Moorland Rambler
runners.spotlight: Very up and down; had one of his better days at Exeter last month (2m5f, good to soft) but was behind Shuil Ceoil and wouldn't be certain to back that up.

runners.comment: Not had a lot of racing and was perhaps stretched by 3m at Taunton last time
runners.name: Lion Of The Desert
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden; tailed off on stable debut (2m2f, soft) but ran better at Taunton when perhaps stretched by the 3m (good to soft); wouldn't be too dismissive but he clearly has a good bit to prove.

runners.comment: He'll need more and this longer trip isn't an obvious positive on ground this slow
runners.name: Times A Wastin
runners.spotlight: Showed talent in Ireland but failed to build on a promising start for Fergal O'Brien and was 10l away on stable debut at Hereford (2m, soft; best form on good); he'll need more and this longer trip isn't an obvious positive on ground this slow.

runners.comment: She's just the type who could raise her profile in handicaps; raised in distance
runners.name: Moonlightinthepark
runners.spotlight: Second in a point; beaten between 15l and 23l in three 2m novice hurdles but she's just the type who could raise her profile in handicaps now sent over further; the tongue-tie is new, replacing a hood tried last time; the betting could be instructive.

runners.comment: Needs a second look with him back in some sort of form and he goes well in the mud
runners.name: Shuil Ceoil
runners.spotlight: Placed on last two starts, though was some 23l and 11l behind the winners (tried a visor last time); still needs a second look with him back in some sort of form and he goes well in the mud.

runners.comment: Could raise his game now into handicaps but a lengthy absence is not ideal
runners.name: Ocean Walz
runners.spotlight: Promising in bumpers, including on soft; lesser efforts over hurdles so far, for previous yard and this one, but he's now making his handicap debut; a lengthy absence is not ideal, however.

runners.comment: May approve of this first crack at a handicap after struggling in novices over shorter
runners.name: My Fortune
runners.spotlight: Not the only one in the field who could approve of this first crack at a handicap after struggling in novice races over shorter; hard to rule out and especially should market vibes bode well.

runners.comment: Tired when pulling up before two out on handicap debut at Hereford (3m1f, soft)
runners.name: Getaway Sam
runners.spotlight: Tired when pulling up before two out on handicap debut at Hereford (3m1f, soft; 12-1); this intermediate trip may suit better but unconvincing.

runners.comment: Dropped to a dangerous mark and this 6yo could stage a revival at some point
runners.name: Catboy
runners.spotlight: Very opposable on this season's exploits but he has dropped to a dangerous mark and this 6yo could stage a revival at some point; worth checking the betting.

runners.comment: Returns to hurdling (dual winner) from 7lb out of the weights and that's not ideal
runners.name: Outback Frontiers
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in a handicap chase here in November but pulled up next time; returns to hurdling (dual winner) from 7lb out of the weights and that's not ideal.

16:42.race_name: Plyvine Catering Chase Meredith Memorial Open Hunters' Chase

runners.comment: Capable on his day but badly let down by his jumping on last two starts
runners.name: Bardenstown Lad
runners.spotlight: Won a point and a Fakenham hunter chase about this time last year before predictably struggling at lengthy odds in the feature hunter chases at Cheltenham and Aintree; badly let down by his jumping in calmer waters afterwards and this 11yo now has much to prove.

runners.comment: Unbeaten in hunter chases after completing a hat-trick between March and May of last year
runners.name: Barton Snow
runners.spotlight: Solid record in points, one he enhanced when winning by a distance at odds-on at Sheriff Hutton 17 days ago (3m, soft); unbeaten in hunter chases after completing a hat-trick between March and May of last year, at Stratford (twice; 2m5f/2m6f) and Cheltenham (2m); strong chance.

runners.comment: Proven in hunter chases and didn't run too badly after an absence at Larkhill
runners.name: What A Glance
runners.spotlight: Won hunter chases in summer of 2024, including on soft ground at Cheltenham (3m1f); lightly raced in the meantime but didn't run too badly after an absence at Larkhill.

runners.comment: Has been handicapping; he's a hunter chase winner with the form to be very competitive
runners.name: Jefferys Cross
runners.spotlight: Contested handicaps in his last three races, after doing well in hunter chases early last year; tailed off when third at Plumpton two runs back and questionable what he achieved in an eventful race here last time; however, he's proven at this level and has the form to be ultra competitive; handles soft but good to soft or good might be preferred.

runners.comment: 2-13 in points; belated first run over regulation fences; held by Barton Snow
runners.name: Prohus Yank
runners.spotlight: 2-13 in points and now having a belated first run over regulation fences; pulled up in two of his last three points and those flank a heavy defeat behind Barton Snow.

runners.comment: Beaten at odds of 2-5 in his penultimate point and was pulled up in the next
runners.name: Rewritetherules
runners.spotlight: Three wins over regulation fences and a multiple point scorer; however, beaten at odds of 2-5 in his penultimate point and was pulled up in the next.

runners.comment: Justified favouritism over C&D last week; remains well treated on historical data
runners.name: Mbappe
runners.spotlight: Justified favouritism, by half a length, in C&D contest last week for a first win since 2024; incurs 5lb penalty but Donagh Murphy claims that amount; remains well treated on historical data anyway; respected, assuming he takes to first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Multiple winner for James Evans; debut for new stable (remains in same ownership)
runners.name: Masqool
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner for James Evans, most recently off current mark last August; slip back down the weights reflects the way his subsequent form has gone; market may offer further guidance on debut for new yard (remains in same ownership).

runners.comment: Revival possible back on AW, being 2-2 in this sphere; debut for another new yard
runners.name: Our Dagger
runners.spotlight: Has changed trainer several times; failed to beat a rival in two turf starts back in Ireland the last twice; needs a big turnaround but may benefit from the return to AW, being 2-2 in this sphere (both wins over 7f); debut for another new stable.

runners.comment: Ran well behind Mbappe last week and the revised terms give her a fighting chance
runners.name: Berning Hot
runners.spotlight: Record is 1-14, the win on turf last summer; beaten just under 2l in the C&D event won by Mbappe last week, posting her best AW effort; the revised terms, with riders' claims factored in, give her a fighting chance in the rematch.

runners.comment: Has form figures of 314 since joining new yard and racing in AW handicaps; player
runners.name: Galaxy Wonder
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 4yo who has form figures of 314 since joining new yard and racing in AW handicaps; dead-heated at Wolverhampton (9.5f) on Boxing Day and ties in with Brinton on his creditable effort at Chelmsford (1m) since; may still have more to offer in this sphere.

runners.breeder: Qatar Bloodstock Ltd S A S U Ecurie De
runners.comment: Gives the impression this return to shorter is worth a go; competitively weighted
runners.name: Age Of Time
runners.spotlight: Both wins at Wolverhampton, the second one off current mark in October (9.5f); below form over middle distances since but gives the impression this return to shorter is worth a go; competitively weighted and may prove resurgent.

runners.comment: Returns to his optimum distance in this second start for new stable
runners.name: Johnjay
runners.spotlight: Never landed a blow at Lingfield (1m2f) on stable/seasonal debut but may fare better with that outing under his belt; has gained both turf wins over 1m and produced his best AW effort over C&D; hood applied.

runners.comment: Largely consistent on AW; half-length second at Chelmsford most recently; solid
runners.name: Brinton
runners.spotlight: Largely consistent AW record includes classified wins last February/March; placed in two handicaps this year, half-length second at Chelmsford (1m) latest; back on career-high mark but again appears to hold solid claims.

runners.breeder: R C Dollar & Hellwood Stud Farm
runners.comment: All AW wins at Wolverhampton; out of sorts of late; enough to prove
runners.name: Port Noir
runners.spotlight: Has registered all AW wins at Wolverhampton; out of sorts of late and has enough to prove back at Kempton for first time in three years; record here reads 4878.

runners.comment: Poor strike-rate; cut little ice in the C&D contest won by Mbappe last week
runners.name: Marchetti
runners.spotlight: Has lots of Kempton form but cut little ice in the C&D contest won by Mbappe last week; still has a poor strike-rate and losing sequence is mounting up.

13:25.race_name: Get Daily Price Boosts At Unibet Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Showed some promise over 1m2f at Chelmsford in sole start for the Gosdens
runners.name: Bronte Beach
runners.spotlight: Showed some promise with keeping-on fourth at Chelmsford (1m2f) last August in sole start for the Gosdens; sold for 16,000gns since; not sure to benefit from drop in trip but market confidence should be heeded.

runners.comment: Sets the standard on best 2yo efforts; much less convincing on 2025 form; stable debut
runners.name: Glistening
runners.spotlight: Sets the standard on best 2yo efforts, namely second-place finishes behind subsequent Listed/Group winners; much less convincing on 2025 form but market support should be noted; sold out of the Gosden yard for 75,000gns since last run.

runners.comment: Ran well at Southwell on stable/seasonal debut; likely player if that form is backed up
runners.name: Nuptown Girl

runners.name: Raffles Wonder
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D (soft) last January and followed up at Carlisle (2m, good) in March; very much of interest on that form but he's struggled on both outings this season and needs to turn things around.

runners.comment: Made all at Plumpton recently on second chase start and a 7lb penalty may not stop her

runners.comment: Below last winning mark but mixed form this season and he needs to raise his game
runners.name: Treaty Boy

runners.name: Ballin Bay

runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Southwell (3m, good to soft) in November before staying-on fourth at Market Rasen (2m7f, good to soft), and game when winning by a head at Catterick (3m1f, good) last time; this in-form 6yo is a key player.

runners.comment: Won this two years ago and good second at Catterick last time; has a big part to play

runners.spotlight: Inconsistent but she won this two years ago (soft) and returned to form when second to a well-handicapped winner at Catterick (3m1f, good to soft) in December; has a big part to play if backing up that latest effort.

runners.name: King Casey

runners.comment: Back on a good mark and might have needed last month's run but is not straightforward

runners.comment: Well beaten in three novice hurdles but ought to me much more competitive in this handicap
runners.name: Peckforton Hills

runners.comment: Just 1-13 over hurdles but arguably ran better than bare form suggests on stable debut

runners.comment: Out of form over 2m this season but on very good mark and worth a glance in the betting

runners.spotlight: Just 1-23 over hurdles, the win gained in 2023; out of form at around 2m this season but this longer trip might suit him better now and he has slipped to a very good mark; worth a glance in the betting.

runners.comment: Came good on recent seasonal debut at Warwick and is open to further improvement

runners.spotlight: Came good over hurdles at eighth attempt, on seasonal debut at Warwick (2m3f, good to soft) 12 days ago; 5lb rise does not look excessive and he could quite plausibly have more improvement to come.

runners.comment: Struggled when 50-1 for first two handicaps (2m/2m3f)

runners.comment: Safely held after racing too freely on both outings this season; tongue-tie refitted

runners.spotlight: Safely held after racing too freely on both outings this season (2m3f/2m1f) and now 0-9 for current stable; competes off another career-low mark and might be aided by refitted tongue-tie here but others appeal more.

runners.comment: 0-11 under all codes and absent since low-key chase run last April

runners.name: Farabove The Limit

runners.comment: Series of good runs since headgear went on; should be in the thick of it once more
runners.name: Onyeisi
runners.spotlight: Blinkered for the first time when winning a 1m2f nursery at Chelmsford in November; placed in all four starts since, the latest over 1m4f at Kempton two weeks ago (first-time visor; heavily backed); should be in the thick of the action once more.

runners.comment: Fine pedigree but modest form in 3 runs at up to 8.6f; potential improver on h'cap debut
runners.name: Saxophonic

runners.comment: Down the field in three 1m AW runs; needs improvement for new trip now handicapping

runners.spotlight: Down the field in three seven-runner maiden/novice events (1m) on AW thus far; could improve for today's longer trip but such progress is a must.

runners.comment: Consistent rather than progressive as a 2yo; encouragement for this new trip on pedigree

runners.comment: First sign of ability on AW debut latest; up in trip for handicap debut; bred to do better

runners.breeder: W H R John And Partners

runners.spotlight: Ended a losing run when winning a 6f classified event at Wolverhampton last month and he has followed that with two placed efforts in handicap company; should remain competitive.

runners.name: Laurens Dream

runners.comment: Latest effort (after wind op and break) was more encouraging; could take a step forward

runners.spotlight: Yet to win a handicap but she is dropping down the weights and her latest Wolverhampton effort (first run for 201 days and after wind surgery) was encouraging, keeping on when things got tight in the home straight; not ruled out.

runners.spotlight: 20-race maiden but there have been several good runs here in recent months, including when second of nine over 7f on Saturday; others preferred for win purposes.

runners.spotlight: Not far behind Spartan Fighter here last month and now 11lb better off; not so good at Southwell last time when the cheekpieces were left off; headgear back on today.

runners.spotlight: Conditions to suit and he arrives on the back of a series of good runs in defeat, including behind Spartan Fighter (twice) and Yorkshire Glory; one to consider.

runners.comment: Good late headway in a stronger C&D event 19 days ago; claims granted a good pace

runners.spotlight: Stayed on for a never-dangerous fifth of nine over C&D 19 days ago; drops in class this time; chance if they go hard early.

runners.comment: AW hat-trick last autumn; off the boil more recently but back below his last winning mark
runners.name: Spun To Gold
runners.spotlight: Reeled off an AW hat-trick last autumn, with two of the wins coming over C&D; gone off the boil more recently but now back below his last winning mark.

runners.comment: On a losing run and he's blown hot and cold since October; minor money perhaps best hope

runners.comment: Modest form in two 7f runs last month; yard in form but he needs major improvement to win
runners.name: Star Of Emerald
runners.spotlight: Modest form in two 7f runs here last month (single-figure price on each occasion); step up in trip can help and the stable are going well but he does need a big step forward to feature.

runners.comment: 66-1, slowly away and finished tailed off on her debut in December (7f); can't recommend
runners.name: Hero Freds Lass
runners.spotlight: 66-1, slowly away and finished tailed off at Southwell (7f) in December; can't be recommended.

runners.comment: Promising second over 7f on debut in December; 1m should suit; open to improvement
runners.name: Pendella
runners.spotlight: It wasn't a strong race in which she finished second at Southwell (7f) on her debut 47 days ago but the winner was well backed and the pair pulled clear of the third; open to improvement and Jack Nicholls takes off a useful 5lb; 1m should suit.

runners.comment: 200-1 and tailed off in two runs last month (7f/1m); no appeal
runners.name: Spirit Of Tokyo
runners.owner: The Tokyo Bay Syndicate And P Kirby
runners.spotlight: 200-1 and tailed off in two runs last month (7f/1m); no appeal.

20:00.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Classified Stakes

runners.comment: Form of latest C&D third looks rock solid for the grade; new headgear; sound claims
runners.name: Annalee Lass
runners.spotlight: Won a Wolverhampton classified event (8.6f) one year ago; promising third in a similar C&D event last month, chasing home two rivals who have more than upheld the form; won't need much of a lift from the change of headgear to play a leading role.

runners.comment: Two wins, including 1m on Tapeta, last year; absent since July but returns at a low level
runners.name: I Can Boogy
runners.spotlight: Two wins in the first half of 2025, over 1m at Southwell and 7f at Redcar; not so good after the latter win but she returns from 202 days off at a low level; worth a market check.

runners.comment: Three-time course winner; hopes rest on return of blinkers and Paul Mulrennan
runners.name: Marcello Si
runners.spotlight: Three course wins in the first half of 2024 but he has drawn a blank since; this winter's efforts don't suggest he is the answer but Paul Mulrennan returns to the saddle and blinkers (only worn once in his last 11 starts and that run was his best RPR in that period) replace cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Multiple C&D winner; yet to fire this winter, including in a similar C&D event last month
runners.name: Pop Favorite
runners.spotlight: Seven of his eight wins have come over C&D, the latest last April; needs to step up on this winter's efforts but it's not out of the question.

runners.comment: On the downgrade and only glimpses of retaining ability this winter; not a solid option
runners.name: Sir Maxi
runners.spotlight: He has been much better than this level in his time but only flashes of retaining ability this winter; got going too late when fourth in a similar C&D event 11 days ago; others appeal more for win purposes.

runners.comment: 0-16 but second to easy winners in similar C&D events on his last two starts; in the mix
runners.name: That Lucas Fella
runners.spotlight: 16-race maiden but he has finished second in similar events over C&D on his last two starts, no match for an easy winner on each occasion; likely to be involved once again.

runners.comment: Third at this level on his last two starts; needs to up his game to end long losing run
runners.name: Wrist Art
runners.spotlight: Won twice in Ireland in the autumn of 2023; fitted with a visor at Wolverhampton last month and ran a fair race in third (9.5f) before filling the same position (as favourite) at Lingfield two weeks ago; each-way shout.

runners.comment: Down the field in two classified events last month; others look safer
runners.name: Yorkstone
runners.spotlight: Won three times in the second half of 2023, including over 1m on Tapeta; down the field in two classified events last month (after 296-day absence); others look stronger.

runners.comment: Conditions to suit and one of the likelier winners dropping back down in class
runners.name: Tasever
runners.spotlight: In good form here last winter and he recorded his fifth course success when winning over this trip in December; easy lead unlikely with Pallas Lord in the field but still likely to give a good account.

runners.comment: One good run (C&D) and three poor ones for current yard; risky despite dropping in class
runners.name: Maui Breeze
runners.spotlight: Ran well when second over C&D in December, her second run for this yard; that effort is sandwiched by three heavy defeats and risky despite dropping into a Class 6.

runners.comment: Poor strike-rate but latest C&D third was a solid effort; opposable for win purposes
runners.name: Sea Legend
runners.spotlight: Just one win to his name after 30 starts but he displayed his wellbeing with a never-dangerous third of ten over C&D two weeks ago; often misses the break.

runners.comment: Two course wins this winter and holding his form well; back down in class tonight; chance
runners.name: Concert Boy
runners.owner: Making Headway Racing And K Scott
runners.spotlight: Two course wins (7f and 1m) in late 2025; several other good runs this winter, bumping into the thriving Aisling Oscar on a few occasions; should go well again back down into a Class 6.

runners.comment: 0-17 and needs to bounce back from a quiet C&D run on New Year's Day; no headgear tonight
runners.name: Sherlock
runners.spotlight: 17-race maiden; ended 2025 with some good efforts, including C&D, but he was disappointing here on New Year's Day (raced too freely); headgear left off today; others preferred for win purposes.

runners.comment: Banging at the door in recent starts, the latest on Saturday; another bold bid expected
runners.name: Pallas Lord
runners.spotlight: Multiple winner who comes here in good form, placed for the fourth time in succession when beaten a neck over C&D on Saturday; another bold bid from the front expected.

runners.comment: Struggled since her 7f win at Chelmsford last May; too much to prove at present
runners.name: Big Gypsy King
runners.spotlight: Ran out the easy winner of a 7f handicap at Chelmsford last May when trained by Paul and Oliver Cole; struggled on the Flat and over hurdles since; return to 1m not enough to tempt.

runners.comment: Well treated on 2yo form; needs a market check dropped into Class 6 company
runners.name: Montpellier Green
runners.spotlight: Promise, including a 7f nursery win at the Curragh, as a 2yo; well held in nine runs for Ian Williams in 2025 (started 22-1 or bigger) but he has dropped 22lb during that period; interesting to see how he goes in the market now dropping into a Class 6.

runners.comment: Poor form in seven runs last year; plenty to prove back from 99 days off
runners.name: Oh So Cool
runners.spotlight: Poor form in seven starts last year; absent since pulled up in a 6f handicap at Catterick in late October; plenty to prove.
